mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the spindle made the two supports and their positions clear, setting up the drive assembly.

leastWorthwhile.text: The belt, guard and wheel sequence was confusing because each appeared in the picture description before its fitting step.

surprise.text: The loop was described between the disks before the belt was fitted.

arbitrary.text: No fitting seemed purposeless, but the premature details made several changes hard to distinguish.

continue.text: I probably would not continue: the construction goals were clear, but the repeated premature details weakened the reward of seeing the drive come together. Text alone cannot establish how clear the artwork looks.
